name: Kapkek
scene: A cherry-topped cupcake with sweeping piped frosting and a pleated wrapper fills an oval panel against flowing blue and turquoise bands.
notes: Design sheet inspected after one correction pass. Subject and background colour pairs stay separate; wrapper pleats and background bands alternate. Closed oval with white exterior. Correction simplified wrapper and frosting divisions. Remaining doubts: mild raster shading needs quantization; central upper frosting has a pinched multiway contact and some cherry/frosting endpoints remain crowded. Review these junctions and a few narrow background tips during tracing while preserving the cupcake silhouette. Target 82–122 panes was requested; final traced count is not verified. This is a design sheet, not audited game geometry.
